changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.0[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Premiere Lists[/COLOR]
-New Premiere Lists: put aside shows that have not premiered yet and new seasons of the shows you follow, in lists you name yourself (for example, "To watch in November"). Lists can be renamed and deleted, and titles removed from them.
-Add to Premiere List... in the context menu of upcoming shows, unaired seasons and upcoming episodes, including the TVmaze, TMDb and Trakt calendars. From a show, luc_kodi picks what is coming next: the show itself if it has not premiered, otherwise its next season.
-Premieres within the next 3 months show a countdown. Shows and seasons without a date yet, or more than 3 months away, wait as Waiting for date until the date is confirmed.
-A notification the day before: Premieres tomorrow. If Kodi was off that day, it tells you on the premiere day instead.
-Once a premiere has aired, it is added to your library on its own, following the same rules as the library (aired episodes only, with the 24HR delay before import). A new season of a show already in your library adds that season's episodes; a show not in your library comes in whole. Titles stay marked In your library for 7 days, then leave the list.
-Premiere dates are checked again on TMDb every 12 hours. If a premiere is postponed or its date is confirmed, a notification tells you.
-Each title in a list has Play Trailer and Remove from list in its context menu, and opens its seasons when selected.
-Premiere Lists runs on its own and needs no account and no library Auto Update Service. Nothing is checked while a video is playing.
-Premiere Lists is in TV Shows > Premiere Calendar and in Tools > Library. Check premieres now, in the context menu of the lists, checks everything at once. Update Library also adds the premieres that have aired.
[COLOR fffdb515]Library[/COLOR]
-Adding a TV show to the library now writes only the episodes that have already aired. Upcoming episodes, announced seasons and shows that have not premiered yet are no longer added ahead of time, so they no longer end up misplaced in Kodi's library.
-An episode is added the day after it airs, or the same day with 24HR delay before import turned off, the same rule the library update already followed. For shows already in the library, Update Library and the Auto Update Service add new episodes once they have aired.
-Episodes without an air date are only added for shows that have ended, following Include episodes with unknown air dates. For shows still running they are announced episodes, and they wait until they have a date and have aired.
-The library now follows its own rule for upcoming episodes, whatever Show unaired seasons/episodes is set to. That setting only changes what the menus show.
-Adding a show that has not aired any episode yet now says so, instead of Title Already Exists in Library. Put it in a Premiere List and it reaches your library on its own when it premieres.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-An announced season with no episodes no longer stops a show halfway through being added: the remaining seasons are written and the library scan starts.
-Shows imported from a list are counted again when one of their seasons is empty. Before, the import logged an error for that show and left it out of the total.
